  | description              = A foul insectoid parasite that crawls into a host's ear, dramatically increasing their host's mental abilities. Terrible rumors abound about what happens when the eggs hatch.

  | tips                     =
*Note that the description when viewing the item is incorrect post-[[Update 14]]. The buff gives a +25 [[psionic bonus]] to spell power rather than the non-stacking +100% spell damage.
* 3 [[Xachosian Larva]] will spawn in your inventory after the [[disease]] effect wears off naturally. Note: Wearing a [[Disease Immunity]] item or having [[Divine Health]] from 3 levels of Paladin when the [[Xachosian Spell Frenzy]] ends, will negate the disease portion and not grant any Larva. It can be re-equipped once infected, but before it wears off, to prevent any stat damage from the disease.
* Each larva when consumed, will apply [[Tasty Larva]] - regenerate 5 spell points every 6 seconds for a 2 minute duration, which allows for 100 spell point regeneration per egg consumed. In public areas the effect is masked by City Regeneration.
*  Being hit with any form of the [[Heal (spell)]] will cure Xachosian Infestation.
* Being a [[Warforged]] does not prevent [[Xachosian Larva]] from spawning after the [[disease]] effect wears off.
* The durability and hardness are very low. Consider doing an [[Adamantine Ritual]] to fix this issue.
}}
